 Order

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The grievance of the petitioner is that the petitioner is owner and Bhumiswami of land survey no.76,
76/2, 77/2 area 3.379 hectare, 0.138 hectare total area 3.517 hectare.
It is submitted that the aforesaid land was acquired for acquisition for rehabilitation of affected persons of Sardar Sarovar Project.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has not been paid any compensation and possession has also not been taken over.

He further submits that since the possession has not been taken over,
therefore, the acquisition of the petitioner's land stands lapsed in view of the provisions of section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He further submits that later on, the respondents have made incorrect entries in the revenue record and the said land has been shown to be government land.
The petitioner sent a legal notice to the respondent.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties,
the present petition stands 2 WP-9981-2024 disposed off with liberty to the petitioner to submit a detailed and comprehensive representation before the respondent no.4/Land Acquisition Officer,
Revenue Tehsil Kukshi District Dhar within the period of 15 days from today and if such representation is submitted before the respondent no.4 within the said period, the respondent no.4 shall consider and decide the same in accordance with law by passing a speaking and reasoned order after affording opportunity of hearing to the petitioner within the period of two months from the date of filling of the representation alongwith the copy of the order passed today.
